goal: Compare NVIDIA and AMD in AI accelerators

report.executive_summary: AMD's MI400 series is challenging NVIDIA's dominance in AI accelerators with competitive performance and memory bandwidth, while NVIDIA continues to lead with its Blackwell architecture.

competitors.name: NVIDIA
competitors.summary: NVIDIA leads in AI accelerators with its Blackwell architecture, including the B200 and B300 models.

competitors.name: AMD
competitors.summary: AMD's MI400 series is a direct competitor to NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture, offering high performance and memory bandwidth.

recent_developments.text: AMD's MI400 series is projected to generate $7.2 billion in revenue in H2 2026.
AMD's MI400 series supports UALink, an open interconnect standard, challenging NVIDIA's NVLink.

market_signals.text: AMD's MI400 series is closing the performance gap with NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture.
AMD is positioning itself as a key player in the AI accelerator market with its MI400 and MI500 series.

risks.text: NVIDIA's Blackwell architecture remains the default choice for AI data center deployments.
AMD's reliance on open standards may face challenges in a market dominated by proprietary solutions.
